ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Threats on Minnesota's Social Services
ideas.description: Investigate the potential impact of the Trump administration's threat to halt federal payments on Minnesota's social services and budget.
questions: What are the potential implications for Minnesota's budget?
How will this affect social services?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover the significant financial implications of the Trump administration's threat and its potential impact on vulnerable populations in Minnesota.
